context: Scénario entièrement fictif de test, sans validation administrative réelle : l’appariement APP-FICTIF-2026-017 concerne un accord entre Espagne et France, académie de Lyon. Les deux établissements fictifs sont Collège fictif des Horizons pour l’établissement français et Instituto ficticio de los Encuentros pour l’établissement partenaire. Le nom de l’académie dans l’attribution au recteur ou à la rectrice est Lyon. Ces références ne désignent aucun dossier réel.
normalization_notes: This source is a one-page letter-style administrative template, not a table. The single-column logical representation follows its printed reading order; no claim of original table grid is made.

Six printed placeholder positions are retained: reference number, foreign country/education authority, French academy, French school, partner school, academy in the rector attribution. No extra signature/date fields are invented from whitespace.

Inline parenthetical placeholders are represented as separate logical text cells within the prose sequence. Their source wording remains visible as labels; filler guides and line wrapping are normalized. Two source discretionary line-break hyphens in établissements and serez are removed, without changing words.
Header text and full footer are retained. Decorative blue bands and typography are omitted. DOCX XML contains no tables, vMerge or structured document controls.
source_path/hash identify the local LibreOffice PDF for anchor verification; the separately hashed original DOCX is the official download. PDF creation time is not publication time.
The two academy placeholders are intentionally distinct targets with consistent synthetic values; they are not collapsed. All case information is fictitious.
